note: Roane County Parks & Recreation campground at the tip of a peninsula on Watts Bar Lake (TVA land), with a boat ramp and two swimming areas. About half the park is long-stay: 22 of its 45 sites are seasonal, let by the month through a spring lottery. --Claude
summary: Riley Creek (Roane County Parks & Rec, confirmed): county map shows 45 sites - 12 'Waterfront', 8 interior, 3 accessible, 22 seasonal (long-term by lottery). County posts no rate, season or booking terms (camper reports: first-come, $20-45). Lakefront kept on the county's own W labels + imagery. Pin ~260 m off; phone differs from the county page.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' kept (consistent): the county's site map labels W-1..W-12 'WATERFRONT' (the S seasonal sites are the separate east-side row, set back in the woods); W-6..W-9 at the NW point and W-10..W-12 on the west shore sit ~15-40 m from the water on Esri/NAIP imagery (around 35.8308,-84.5282 and 35.8300,-84.5281). 3DEP puts the tip-loop ground at ~228 m against Watts Bar's 741-ft (225.9 m) summer pool, about 2 m - passes the kayak test on a gentle bank; Watts Bar is a mainstem lake with only ~2 m winter drawdown. A 2025 camper (campendium) says 'our site was one of the ones right next to it'. W sites are not marked seasonal, so they appear to sell by the night. Caveat: leaf-off imagery shows a tree fringe on parts of the west bank; the old evidence's 'open tan/grass apron' was partly winter drawdown sand and the swim beach at the tip (day use) - replacement evidence: 'County site map labels W-1..W-12 Waterfront; NW-point and west-shore W sites 15-40 m from the water, ground ~2 m above summer pool (3DEP); camper 2025: site right next to the lake.'
PIN: stored 35.82810,-84.52613 sits in forest ~260 m SE of the campground; the loops centre on about 35.8302,-84.5273 (imagery). Suggest moving it there.
PHONE: 865-250-4286 -> 865-250-6152 (posted for Riley Creek Campground on roanecountytn.gov/parks-and-recreation/; The Dyrt also gives 250-6152 for information).

LONG-STAY (local, not price-gated): 22 of 45 sites are seasonal on the county's own map, monthly rent by lottery ('the first month's rent is due within 48 hours'); camper reviews 2022 'mostly filled by long term campers with boats', The Dyrt 'During summer and fall the campground may have very few openings'. 23 W/I/H sites remain for ordinary stays - note says so. Not a drop as read.
FEES not written: the county posts no rate. Camper reports only: $20 a night (The Dyrt, 2026-09-19), $40 (campendium, 2026-05-26), $45 (2025-04-07).
